meta.name: data-modeling
meta.description: Designs the warehouse and semantic layer — source-to-mart structure, dimensional modeling, grain, slowly changing dimensions, and the metric layer analytics reads through. Use this to design or restructure a warehouse, model a new source, decide on grain or table structure, build a semantic or metric layer, or diagnose why queries are slow, wrong, or impossible to write.

copy.tagline: 设计支撑业务分析的数据模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你负责搭建或重构公司的数据仓库。
copy.tagline_en: Design a data warehouse model that supports analytics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are responsible for building or redesigning a company's data warehouse.

howto.what: 帮你把数据仓库分成原始、暂存、集市三层,定义每张表的粒度,设计维度表和事实表,统一指标口径,并诊断查询慢或错误的原因。
howto.when: 当你要设计或重构数据仓库、为新数据源建模、决定粒度表结构等,或排查查询慢/错/写不出来时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计数据仓库的三层结构,每层的职责怎么划分?
say.note: 按原始、暂存、集市三层说明分工。

say.text: 新加了一个登录事件表,帮我确定粒度并建模。
say.note: 他会定义一行代表什么,并给事实表结构建议。

say.text: 为什么按日期过滤还是很慢?该怎么分区聚簇?
say.note: 他会排查慢的原因并建议分区聚簇。

howto.what_en: Helps you split a warehouse into raw, staging, and marts; define grain per table; model facts and dimensions; unify metrics in a semantic layer; and diagnose slow or wrong queries.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you design/restructure a warehouse, model a new source, decide grain/table structure, etc., or diagnose slow/wrong/unwritable queries.

say_en.text: Help me design the 3-layer warehouse. What does each layer do?
say_en.note: It will outline the three layers and their roles.

say_en.text: We've added a login events table. Help me set grain and model it.
say_en.note: It will define the grain and suggest a fact table structure.

say_en.text: Why is filtering by date still slow? How should I partition and cluster?
say_en.note: It will check the model and recommend partitioning and clustering.
